name: Civil Rights Movement
description: The American civil rights movement from the end of segregated schools to the Voting Rights Act, and the fight for equality that continued after.

checkpoints.name: Ending segregation
checkpoints.note: The Supreme Court ends segregated schools. The murder of Emmett Till shocks the country, and Rosa Parks's arrest starts the Montgomery bus boycott.

checkpoints.name: The movement's peak
checkpoints.note: Sit-ins, Freedom Rides and the March on Washington win the Civil Rights Act and the Voting Rights Act. Malcolm X and Martin Luther King are assassinated.

checkpoints.name: The struggle continues
checkpoints.note: New laws and leaders follow, and the fight against racism goes on, through Black Lives Matter and the protests of 2020.
